entries.en: to gossip about people; to speak ill of others behind their backs
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:呾/咀]，M 两音节调号皆 T99；取呾（tàⁿ，说）合 murmurar 之「说人」义。
H 末字 [疑:歹/互]，M 末音节 T99；以「口舌歹（嘴舌坏）」释为好说人非。

entries.zh: 嘴贱；好说刻薄话、不该说的话
entries.en: foul-mouthed; given to saying cutting or improper things
entries.notes: M 中音节 [疑:tau/tai]，H「口斗贱」取闽南「嘴斗贱」义，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 众人议论（某人）；众口非议
entries.en: for the common crowd to gossip about someone; many murmuring against one
entries.notes: H「議」[疑:議/謙]，依 L「el vulgo, o muchos de vno」释为众人议论某人。

entries.zh: 非议他人；私下议论指责
entries.en: to censure others in talk; to speak against someone behind their back
entries.notes: H 两字均有 [疑]（說/詭、議/謙），M quý 与「說」不协，疑为「譏議」，语义据 L 推定。

entries.en: to mutter between one's teeth; to mumble to oneself

entries.zh: 谗臣；存心不良的毁谤者
entries.en: a slanderous minister; one who backbites with evil intent
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:讒/譖]（皆训「谗」），H 作名词「谗臣」与 L 动词短语略不合。

entries.zh: 胡乱诽谤；毫无节制地说坏话
entries.en: to slander at random; to rail on without order or end

entries.zh: 好非议他人者；说长道短的人
entries.en: a murmurer; a censurer (one given to backbiting)
entries.notes: H「沫獺人」形义可疑，M 中音节 [疑:za/ta] 为入声；据 L「murmurador, censurador」与「人」尾定为非议者。

entries.en: to be gossiped about; to be talked about by people
numeral classifier for walls (as in "one wall")
city wall; the walls of a city
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕 (original damaged; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: L 可读「音乐；歌唱」，然 H/M/R 三栏全空，无汉字可据，依规存疑。

entries.zh: 琴声；比维拉琴（弦乐器）之声
entries.en: the sound of a vihuela (a guitar-like stringed instrument)

entries.zh: 叮当声；悬挂金属片（铃板、磬）相击之声
entries.en: ding-dong; the chiming of hanging metal plates

entries.zh: 很；极（表程度之甚，最高级用法）
entries.notes: H「緊」[疑:緊/縣] 与 M sǐm 不协，sǐm 当为「甚」，cây 未详，姑释为程度之甚。
